[[Marauder King Corthan|Corthan]] (former lover)}} '''Zetharia''' was the daughter of the [[Forgotten Keeper|Keeper of Zeth]],{{questlong|Neutral|37|The Last Corthan}} the high priest of the eponymous Zethi religion, which existed during the time of the [[Corthan|Kingdom of Corthan]]. A love feud between her and the last [[Marauder King Corthan|Marauder King of Corthan]] resulted in the doom of the nation after she made a pact with the [[Lord of Everlasting Death]].{{questlong|Neutral|37|The Curse of Zetharia}} == History == At some point in time during the end of Corthan's existence, Zetharia entered into a marriage arrangement with Marauder King Corthan. On the day of their marriage Corthan appeared with his commoner mistress. This display of unfaithfulness angered Zetharia greatly, who spent days in her room poring over tomes of knowledge, seeking revenge on Corthan. At this time, Zetharia contacted and made a deal with the Lord of Everlasting Death, from whom she cursed Corthan and his kingdom to endure an eternity of undeath. Zetharia would go on to roam the wastes of the Badlands, seeking for more souls to torture.{{questlong|Neutral|44+|Undoing the Curse}} ==Objective of== * {{questlong|Neutral|44+|Undoing the Curse}} == References == {{reflist}} [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Badlands mobs]] [[Category:Azotha]]
